tests.result: Six far-camera fixtures cover distances 19.0, 19.999999 and 20.0 m crossed with 85 and 200 mm lenses. Two world translations of the 20 m/200 mm case use (77,70,75) and (-77,-70,-75), moving subject/camera/lights and explicit aim targets consistently. The eight required fixtures remain present; generator also prepares 25 other diagnostic fixtures outside the strict-eight receipt.

tests.check: Maximum channel error and exit status enforcement
tests.result: compare() includes maximum<=maximumAllowedError in PASS conjunction; main parses strict integer 0...255, compares every supplied fixture and returns 1 on failed comparison or 2 on invalid input. CI explicitly passes --maximum-channel-error 1 and enables set -euo pipefail, so tee cannot mask a harness failure. Actual job output contains the same command and shell setting.

Generator requires exactly width*height mask entries with flags in 0...1 and encodes unsupported as reference alpha 0. Harness validates both output/reference alpha as 0 or 255; requires magenta RGB for unsupported; verifies header vs reference unsupported count, output count vs header, and zero per-pixel mask mismatches, independently of RGB metrics.

Parsed exactly eight distinct fixture names matching the expected set. All report mean=0, max=0, >4 fraction=0, invalid-mask-mismatches=0, max-limit=1, PASS. In receipt order matching invalid counts are 49/49, 9/9, 19/19, 13/13, 19/19, 13/13, 19/19, 19/19. These diagnostics allow matching unsupported pixels; zero unsupported pixels is the separate twelve-image requirement.
